values.note: Every site must be reserved on recreation.gov; no first-come camping. Stays are limited to 6 nights April 1 - August 31 and 13 nights (14 days) September 1 - November 30. A site must be occupied within 24 hours of the first reserved day and not left unattended for more than 24 hours, or it may be cancelled. Up to 10 people and 2 vehicles a site.

note: BLM (Kremmling Field Office) campground and the busiest put-in on the Upper Colorado between Kremmling and State Bridge, between Gore Canyon and Hartman Canyon, reached by Trough Road (the Colorado Headwaters Byway) and Grand County Road 106. Three boat ramps, the Gore Canyon Whitewater Playpark and foot trails up and down the river. Seasonal drinking water may run May-October but is not reliable and is not for filling RV tanks; no cell service without a booster. Supplies in Kremmling, ~15 miles east. --Claude

flags: Length: the BLM/recreation.gov text gives 'For campsites 1-8, driveway parking is 35 feet or less in length' (catalog: 1, 2 and 5 at 35; 3 and 4 at 30; 6-8 at 20) and 'Campsites 9-18 are parallel parking and typically have space for two vehicles and small trailers' (catalog Driveway Length 60). The stored 60 was the parallel-parking length; recorded 35. The 'small trailers' wording at 9-18 has no figure, and sites 1, 2 and 5 take 35 ft, so a 23-ft rig fits.
Max stay: 6 nights April 1 - August 31, 13 nights September 1 - November 30 (recreation.gov notice and rules). Recorded 6 in max_stay_nights; the fall figure is in booking.note.

Waterfront riverview confirmed (no change): the Colorado River here is ~50-60 m wide (a river). On Esri imagery sites 6-8 sit ~35-40 m from the water, but a road, the boat-ramp parking and a riparian tree band lie between, so not an open apron; sites 9-18 on the southwest loop are ~50-80 m back up a slope. A view, not riverfront.

Pin 39.987278,-106.508467 (the recreation.gov facility point) is at the entrance building: sites 1-8 are 60-130 m west, but sites 9-18 are on a separate loop ~450-600 m to the southwest (catalog 39.9833-39.9853, -106.5140 to -106.5133). Worth noting; not moved.
Phone 970-724-3000 confirmed (BLM page and recreation.gov, Kremmling Field Office).
